faces: F1 applyNamedState() does not clear the observer -> the same fight pays +384 then +0 (W1-SOULS-r2 HF-1)
F2 post release + re-materialise under the stable post-id tag recycles eids onto NEW full-HP bodies -> 5 live hostiles worth 0 (W1-SOULS-r2 HF-2)
F3 applySave() DOES clear it while death.ordinaryRespawnEpoch does not move -> unbounded save/load farm (W1-POPULATION-r1 §2, GAP-W1-population-save-reload-repays-every-corpse)
the_class.note: F2 and F3 pull in OPPOSITE directions off the same key. That is the proof the key is wrong rather than the sign being wrong.
fix_shape: identity: the ledger records the BODY (the entity object minted by makeEntity), not the name. A recycled eid on a new record is a new body and pays; a revived record is the same body and stays gated on the S5 rest epoch.
boundary: ONE list of per-session observers shared by applyNamedState() and the blob path, instead of two hand-maintained lists that have already drifted (souls is in one, not the other).
